fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 38% match is a weak fit for this Elasticsearch search role.

**Strengths:**
- Java plus Kotlin and Spring Boot, running the settlement service
- Cut p99 latency from 480 ms to 120 ms (PostgreSQL to Redis)
- Led 4 engineers through a 9 month monolith-to-services migration

**Gaps:**
- No Elasticsearch, Lucene or Solr experience (core must-haves)
- No vector search work: HNSW, IVF, vector databases
- No search relevance or search algorithm design background

**Recommendation:** Build a hands-on Lucene and Elasticsearch vector search project, then contribute to the open-source codebase before applying.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Elastic

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Search Relevance team needs engineers who can make a Java codebase faster and easier to understand, and I've done that on a hot path. When the payment status API at Lumen Payments was slow, I moved its hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis and cut p99 latency from 480 ms to 120 ms.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Lumen, I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot on Kafka, and I wrote Java and PostgreSQL services for 6 years before that. I haven't worked on search engines, vector databases or Lucene, so I'd be learning that domain, but I bring the data storage and debugging habits the role depends on: on-call ownership of a payments platform, post-incident reviews, and code review as a daily practice. I also led a team of 4 engineers through a monolith-to-services migration, which taught me to guide a project from technical design to delivery. Your distributed, GitHub-based way of working fits how I like to collaborate, and I've contributed small bug fixes to an open-source Kotlin library.

I'd welcome a conversation about how my Java and data storage background could support your vector search work. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Hello Elastic hiring team,

I've built backend services in Java and Kotlin for over a decade, and at Lumen Payments I led a team of engineers through a migration from a monolith to services. I also sped up a busy payment API by changing how hot reads were served, and I care about code review and keeping a codebase readable and easy to maintain. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a call any weekday afternoon, Toronto time.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
